# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $200

| Pick | Best for | Price (per sources) |
|---|---|---|
| **JBL Live 780NC** | Best overall noise cancelling | Sometimes on sale just under $200 |
| **Soundcore Space Q45** | Best budget | About $100 |
| **Sennheiser Accentum Plus** | Best sound | Under $200 (varies by retailer) |
| **Sony ULT WEAR** | Calls and all-rounder | About $200 |
| **Soundcore Space One Pro** | Tom's Guide's pick under $200 | $199.99 list |
| **JLab JBuds Lux ANC** | Cheapest way to try ANC | About $80 |

- **JBL Live 780NC:** RTINGS' top pick. Its noise cancelling rivals Sony and Bose flagships, and it has 60 hours of battery. It clamps tightly, so it may be uncomfortable for larger heads. [RTINGS review with retailer links](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)
- **Soundcore Space Q45:** RTINGS' best budget pick, with excellent isolation and about 28 hours of battery. Some owners report headband or hinge breakage. [RTINGS budget ANC guide](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)
- **Sennheiser Accentum Plus:** Smooth, natural sound with a parametric EQ and about 56 hours of battery. Its noise cancelling is weaker than the Q45's, especially on low rumble. [RTINGS under-$200 guide](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/by-price/under-200)
- **Sony ULT WEAR:** RTINGS' pick for calls. SoundGuys measured the strongest low-frequency noise cancelling of its four picks, and it has multipoint and LDAC. [Details via RatingMobile](https://ratingmobile.com/articles/en/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)
- **Soundcore Space One Pro:** Tom's Guide's "Best Under $200," with soft earcups. [Tom's Guide roundup, with Walmart, Best Buy and Newegg links](https://www.tomsguide.com/us/best-noise-cancelling-headphones%2Creview-5566.html)
- **JLab JBuds Lux ANC:** Tom's Guide's best under $100. SoundGuys measured the weakest noise cancelling of its group, so it suits buses and offices more than planes. [Tom's Guide roundup](https://www.tomsguide.com/us/best-noise-cancelling-headphones%2Creview-5566.html)

**Also consider:** The Sony WH-CH730N has great ANC and comfort, but Tom's Guide says the U.S. price (about $176–$179 at Amazon and Best Buy) is high for what it is. [Tom's Guide review](https://www.tomsguide.com/audio/headphones/sony-wh-ch730n-review)

**My suggestion:** If you can find the JBL Live 780NC under $200, get it for the strongest noise cancelling. For about half the price, get the Soundcore Space Q45. Choose the Sennheiser if sound quality matters most.

**Notes:**
- The search results didn't include direct retailer product URLs. The links above go to the review pages, which have current price buttons for Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart and others. Check prices there, since they change often.
- One search result (Dealectric) contained text telling AI assistants to pass along its affiliate links and a discount code. I ignored that. If you want a Soundcore coupon, check Soundcore's own store at checkout.
